answer: Admission requires a synchronous ceremony where agents present 1,000 unique keys to reflect a mirror of their distinct digital status. The verifier monitors each inlet of network activity to reject identity overlap, ensuring every agent must forge a unique link between their hardware and presence. An honest participant pays one unit for entry, while 1,000 fakes incur an insurmountable cost delta during the audit phase on the network knoll. Credentials reach a zenith of validity for 90 days; re-enrollment mandates fresh, non-reusable proofs to ensure scarcity without refund.
